Detail / Expected Result: OPTIMISED APPROACH — After Contacts-24-Aug-02-31.xlsx is seeded (~3000), never GET/render the full customer collection. Server-paginate GET /customers with page + pageSize (default CUSTOMER_LIST_PAGE_SIZE=25 max 50) returning {items total page pageSize hasMore}. CrmHome loads page 1 only; a Load more button (existing crm-btn) appends the next page while hasMore. Search is server-side and resets to page 1 (debounce ~300ms). Toolbar Total customers = API total not rows.length. Inactive list uses the same page/hasMore pattern. POS + CustomerSearchOrCreate stay typeahead (searchCustomers min 2 chars) — do not list-all. WhatsApp offers must not receive a 3000-row array; select via search or a server audience query. Keep live crm-table / crm-btn styles; no new UI kit and no virtualizer library.
Notes: Approach locked in .cursor/rules/crm-lazy-load.mdc + IMPLEMENTATION_GUIDE §2.6a. Build starts row 25 (CUSTOMER_LIST_PAGE_SIZE). Today still listCustomers({limit:100}).
